import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    readings = inputs["readings"].copy()

    cols = ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]

    # Row-level bad flag
    def is_bad(v):
        return pd.isnull(v) or v < 0 or v > 1000

    if len(readings) == 0:
        readings["is_bad"] = pd.Series(dtype=bool)
    else:
        readings["is_bad"] = readings["value"].apply(is_bad)

    # Per-batch stats
    grp = readings.groupby("batch_id")["is_bad"].agg(["sum", "count"]).reset_index()
    grp.columns = ["batch_id", "bad_count", "total_count"]
    grp["quarantine"] = grp["bad_count"] * 100 > grp["total_count"] * 20
    grp["batch_reject_pct"] = (grp["bad_count"] * 100.0 / grp["total_count"]).round(2)

    quarantine_batches = set(grp.loc[grp["quarantine"], "batch_id"])
    pct_map = dict(zip(grp["batch_id"], grp["batch_reject_pct"]))

    readings["_quarantine"] = readings["batch_id"].isin(quarantine_batches)

    quarantine_df = readings[readings["_quarantine"]].copy()
    quarantine_df["batch_reject_pct"] = quarantine_df["batch_id"].map(pct_map)
    quarantine_df = quarantine_df[cols + ["batch_reject_pct"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    non_quarantine = readings[~readings["_quarantine"]]

    clean_df = non_quarantine[~non_quarantine["is_bad"]][cols].reset_index(drop=True)
    rejects_df = non_quarantine[non_quarantine["is_bad"]][cols].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "readings_clean": clean_df,
        "readings_rejects": rejects_df,
        "readings_quarantine": quarantine_df,
    }
